programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot

Työpäivien aikana vastaan tulee kaikkea mahdollista salametsästäjistä tulvien uhreihin ja vaarallisiin villieläimiin. Riistanvalvojat etsivät Länsi-Teksasin vuorilta arkoja isosarvisia lampaita. He jäljittävät jousella metsästävää henkilöä, jonka oma riistakamera antoi hänet ilmi.

Nämä liskot ja ötökät ovat monstereita, jotka hallitsevat elinympäristöään miltei yliluonnllisilla kyvyillään: ne voivat esimerkiksi muuttaa muotoaan ja ampua myrkyllistä verta silmistään. (Little Giants, dokumenttisarja, USA, 2019)

programme.title: Uskomattomat uima-altaat

programme.title: Shark Attack Files

programme.title: Erakkoperhe erämaassa

programme.title: Teksasin riistanvalvojat

programme.title: I'm Alive

programme.title: My Tiny Terror

Indians who signed up to the indenture system were sent to work in the Caribbean, Africa and south east India. And convicts from Britain and Ireland were dispatched to the new territory of Australia.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: Davis presents parthenogenesis, asexual reproduction, notably in species which are capable of sexual breeding too. Sometimes it's the way for a population to be established by a single colonizing female, as Komodo dragons did on various smaller Insulind islands. Sometimes cloning is deemed ideal for a species perfectly adapted to its environment, albeit a gamble on the long run to give up natural variation. Often however it's combined with sexual reproduction in a complex seasonal s-cycle, as with aphids, whose females also breed pregnant offspring, so as to clone themselves fast in huge numbers.

However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger¿s house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this bear's privilegeexcept the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Daphne heeft altijd al gedroomd om buitenaards leven te ontmoeten, maar die droom verandert in een nachtmerrie wanneer de gang verstrikt raakt in het mysterie van een eng alienmonster en naar Area 53 - een overheidsfaciliteit die zo geheim is dat het twee nummers meer is dan Area 51 - wordt gebracht!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans!

programme.title: Season
programme.desc: Ben finds it difficult to enjoy his voyage aboard the SS Pettigrew due to his seasickness, but he must overcome his illness to prevent Steam Smythe and his group of mechanical creatures from sinking the steamship and the passengers aboard.

programme.title: Season
programme.desc: After their attempt to get a photo with every storefront mascot is foiled, Ben and Gwen sneak out at night to get their photo with the wooden bear totem known as Yawk, only to find he and the other mascots have come to life.

programme.title: Season
programme.desc: Ben has a dental appointment after a cavity is discovered, but his visit to the dentist takes a turn for the worse when the sinister magician Hex transports Ben to a nightmarish dreamscape, where his worst fears are brought to life.

programme.title: Season
programme.desc: Moviegoers at a drive-in theater are subjected to a real fright when the malevolent magician Hex brings to life a movie monster called That, and it's up to Ben and Gwen to stop the terrying monster from attacking the moviegoers.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: A local archaeology dig inspires Bean to go in search of treasure. But why buy a metal detector when you can make one from lawnmower parts and a dustbin lid? After destroying his landlady’s back garden, Mr. Bean tries out his hand-made contraption in the woods. He is overjoyed to discover a buried chest of gold doubloons. However, his happiness is soon thwarted by the arrival of two baddies, the police and a very angry Landlady.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs. Wicket gathers up all her valuables for safekeeping after witnessing a burglary, but the sudden appearance of an admirer makes Mr. Bean suspicious.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper. Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares – with a rather sickly ending.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: The Lady of the Manor's prize Pomeranian, Alfred, must get some pounds off before the big dog show. The butler suggests exercise—chasing a cat perhaps? Tom happily obliges, as Alfred's successful weight loss guarantees him a cushy spot upstairs. Meanwhile, Jerry aims to sabotage Tom's efforts.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: When Rick and Ginger go to a couple's retreat, they leave Tom with Rick's Auntie Louella. Hearing that she's a whiz in the kitchen, Jerry comes along. The old woman is sweet, but she has a nasty little lap dog that bedevils Tom like crazy. Louella keeps treating Tom poorly, and Tom and Jerry make their plans to escape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: The Lady of the House's cousins, the Van der Snoots, visit with their prize-winning Persian cat, Prancy Van der Snoot. Tom is warned to make sure that Snooty doesn't catch sight of the pesky manor mice, lest she get upset or dirty her snowy white paws chasing the vermin. Tom is on it, but nothing goes as planned...

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion. The stage ends up in tatters by the time the actual band arrives. Those Docs are a hard act to follow.

programme.title: Wabbit: A Looney Tunes Production
programme.desc: Sir Littlechin the Knight tries to capture a dragon./Wile E. Coyote attempts to show Bugs the future of yard maintenance.

programme.title: Wabbit: A Looney Tunes Production
programme.desc: Bigfoot pops in for an unexpected visit, and Bugs decides it is high time Bigfoot learned a few things regarding etiquette. / Yosemite Sam escapes from jail only to discover he is woefully uninformed regarding banking in the 21st century. He elicits Bugs' help, who is more than happy to assist.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blowup sumotori costume. Grizzy is roughly chucked out of the living room area. He decides to follow a special sumo diet to become the strongest guy around.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He's too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city-shaking shenanigans.

programme.desc: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. / When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover! / When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur. / When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur.

programme.title: Batwheels

These stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Get ready for an epic showdown as the Batwheels take on their fierce rivals, the Legion of Zoom, in thrilling Heroes vs. Villains episodes. Who will come out on top?

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover! / Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. / Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! / Redbird sacrifices his muffler to sound louder.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr Bean’s picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Everyone in Mushton is finding that their precious wooden things are being munched and destroyed by someone or something. All the evidence points toward Truff's new woodworm pet: Chompski. But Truff refuses to believe Chompski would do such a thing! It's up to Chep, Lilit and Mush-Mush to convince Truff. But first they have to catch Chompski in the act!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: If Mush-Mush had Bolly’s speed, he’d want everyone to see just how awesomely fast he was. But Bolly is different – he just likes to use his speed helping Mushables. So when Mush-Mush organizes a big stunt for Bolly, he refuses. He just doesn’t like to show off. But Mush-Mush promised everyone a show so a show he will give them – with Mush-Mush performing instead of Bolly! Gulp!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Chep becomes obsessed with learning all about Mushlore -- all the funny little traditions and things that Mushables believe in.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Starmush's back is stuck, and the Mushelder has no choice but to ask for help in Mushton. Because Chep is the one that finds a solution to his back problem, Starmush chooses him to help with his daily activities. But Mush-Mush is jealous, he would have loved being the chosen one...

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Chep is so good at moss-marbles, no one wants to play him anymore! No one except Sumush who reveals himself to be a tough competitor. To Chep’s disbelief, Sumush keeps on winning. But Lilit and Mush-Mush convince their friend not to give up. Chep decides to play his favourite moss-marble: the Rollinator. The one marble he never risked playing before...

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Chanterelle sees how good Lilit is at painting, she offers to help her dig into her talent. But Lilit’s art lessons conflict with the fun project she has been working on with Mush-Mush and Chep. And when she sees that her friends are having a great time without her, Lilit is seriously annoyed which her paintings start showing…

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is jealous of the Lemmings’ new game: an interactive dance mat connected to the TV where the idea is to jump around and perform dance sequences. As they fight over the mat, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism in one of the Great Wall of China’s watchtowers. The mechanism activates a game on the wall’s paving stones that is similar to the interactive mat, only life size. On your marks, get ready, dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are hungry! While fighting over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the jar is destroyed. But Grizzy discovers an ingenious manner to recover the remains of another Yummy jar using instant Chinese noodles as inspiration. The result is delicious. Grizzy and the Lemmings will once again fight over this new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings, who are both starving, discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche. According to the book lying open inside the temple, to obtain a perfect brioche you must gather three gold ingredients and set them on the altar. When the panda idol who guards the temple receives the offering, the person will receive his favorite food in abundance. Grizzy and Lemmings set out to find the sacred ingredients but there is no question of working together. May the best critter win!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: An integrated circuit containing an artificial intelligence accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life like a modern-day Pinocchio. Grizzy educates the chip until it decides to connect to the Lemmings’ robot to play with them. When the AI becomes a teenager, it is no longer interested in either Grizzy or the Lemmings and prefers using a smartphone to keep learning. Grizzy and the Lemmings join efforts to try and reset the chip’s memory and relive its childhood phase over and over.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a large silkworm that produces an extremely soft and resilient elastic thread ad infinitum. The Lemmings consider the worm the ideal game companion, but Grizzy needs the worm to make his knitwear. To become masters of the silkworm, the close enemies will go to harsh extremes.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean embarks on plenty of adventures, along with his sidekick, Teddy. They try to stay out of the way of Mrs Wicket and her cat Scrapper, but often end up in trouble.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mushpie loves to sing. Only problem she is terrible at it! But Lilit, who has never heard her sing before, wants to make Mushpie happy and organizes a concert for her to sing in front of all the other Mushables... who are terrified at the idea! But Lilit doesn't have the heart to admit this to Mushpie.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Mushpot wishes he could roll back the seasons and relive being a Mushler, our friends get him to hang out doing cool Mushler stuff. But this just shows that Mushpot is no longer able to do all those things. Sigh! However, when our friends find a map that points to a treasure he buried when he was a Mushler, Mushpot realises it's just the Mushler experience he needed.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush can't figure out why his sense foot keeps buzzing like crazy... until an earthquake shakes the forest. Mush-Mush is sure he predicted it! Convinced he can now predict the future, Mush-Mush starts making predictions for everyone in Mushton...

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Everyone in Mushton is finding that their precious wooden things are being munched and destroyed by someone or something. All the evidence points toward Truff's new woodworm pet: Chompski. But Truff refuses to believe Chompski would do such a thing! It's up to Chep, Lilit and Mush-Mush to convince Truff. But first they have to catch Chompski in the act!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: If Mush-Mush had Bolly’s speed, he’d want everyone to see just how awesomely fast he was. But Bolly is different – he just likes to use his speed helping Mushables. So when Mush-Mush organizes a big stunt for Bolly, he refuses. He just doesn’t like to show off. But Mush-Mush promised everyone a show so a show he will give them – with Mush-Mush performing instead of Bolly! Gulp!

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: You never can tell when inspiration’s gonna strike. Specs and Skinny are having a nice evening at the theatre, enjoying a magic show, when the perfect Lamput-catching strategy falls right in their lap! “The perfect strategy” is a magic necklace of invisibility. “Falling in their lap” is stealing it from the magician’s dressing room. Specs and Skinny waste no time tracking Lamput down and ruining a perfectly good picnic. As usual the Docs snatch defeat from the jaws of victory when Lamput gets a hold of the necklace. Now the orange blob can morph AND go invisible. No fair!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy pinches a magic statue from the Lemmings that has the power to make objects appear in real life. All you have to do, is pin the photo of one's desires upon it. Too bad for the rodents' snow-bike! Grizzy replaces the vehicle's photo with the portrait of his beloved she-bear who stayed behind in Canada. Barely arrived in African, the she-bear disappears again, victim of the rodents' trickery. It is the outbreak of a bitter dispute.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Annoyed by the Lemmings' new magnetic train, Grizzy propels the whole lot of them far from the cabin. The rodents land in the neighboring hut of a sorcerer and a mysterious mask falls onto one of them, endowing him with the power of telekinesis. The Lemmings are thrilled! They return to the cabin to explore this new magic power. Perched upon pieces of furniture, they fly around the room to finish their life-size flying train game!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy chases after the Lemmings, who have loaded a jar of Yummy into their remote-control driven car. Where the bear gets to the gas station, he destroys the vehicle and recovers the chocolate spread. programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys an expensive dress for Irma which he plans to return - so has to protect it from damage. / Mr Bean is stuck in a lift and starts to annoy the other passengers.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series

programme.title: Batwheels

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Chep is very excited: tonight, a rare and extremely stinky plant is going to bloom! But he already promised Mush-Mush to play their favourite game. When he chooses the flower instead, Mush-Mush is angry and the two friends stop talking. But when Mush-Mush realises that Chep is about to miss the blooming, he decides he won’t let that happen and helps his friend!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit take their compost meals back to their home-tree to eat, they think they have made a great new discovery.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit are playing dares and having a lot fun. All the Mushables are happy for them except Fung and Miff who keep mocking them. When Mush-Mush reply they should play together to see how fun it is, Fung and Miff accept. Mush-Mush surprisingly gets along with Fung and Miff... until one dare too many.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: While they are enjoying the longest day of the summer, Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit realise that the forest is drying out. Worried, Mushpot explains to our friends that the Tree of Life, that regenerate the entire forest, is dying! There is only one Mushable who could help Mushpot to save the forest: Starmush. But the Mushelders haven’t gotten along for years. Will they be able to put their differences aside in order to save the Tree of Life before it’s too late?

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush wants to be just like Starmush when he grows up, because he’s convinced that Starmush is the most awesome Mushable there is and that his daily life must be extraordinary. So, Mush-Mush trails Starmush, which soon annoys the Mushelder. To get rid of Mush-Mush, Starmush decides to live up to the Mushler’s fantasies…

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. Grizzy is not very enthusiastic about this new electric activity which keeps him from sleeping. While Grizzy thinks that he got rid of their lanterns, the Lemmings discover new high-tech lanterns capable of making even more of a ruckus.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console that lets you play life-sized games in the real world. The console emits magical streams of energy that randomly pick avatars to confront one another. Grizzy is chosen as the hero. He must leap onto platforms and confront both enemies and a fearsome leader: a panda equipped with bamboo sticks. The Lemmings are obviously in control of the joystick!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: As the Lemmings rummage through an abandoned delivery tricycle filled with strange objects, they discover a delicious treasure: Yummy-filled Chinese brioches! Grizzy steals their tasty bounty and heads off to enjoy it alone in the cabin. The Lemmings find a mask in the tricycle that terrifies anyone who looks at it when it’s being worn by someone. The Lemmings intend to use their horrific new power to recover their stolen treats.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of Yummy which is mysteriously sucked up into a strange gravestone locked with a puzzle. Grizzy smashes open the gravestone but it contains another box made of unbreakable wood protected with a codex system. Our characters crack the code and are sucked into the box in turn. They discover that to get out, they will have to resolve a series of new puzzles, each one more complex than the last.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant home cinema screen that transforms his favorite documentary film into an incredible light and sound experience. But his pleasure is ruined by the Lemmings’ fiesta. While he chases after his housemates to destroy their disco equipment, he discovers with astonishment that Asian clones of himself and the Lemmings are also engaged in a high-speed pursuit.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: The Dip

programme.title: Ajavaod. Ärimehed
programme.desc: 1940. aastal natsionaliseeris nõukogude võim Eestis tol ajal tegutsenud 71 kirjastust. Suurem osa neist olid väikesed ja paljud tänaseks unustusse vajunud. Aga mõnda mäletatakse. Üks neist on Kirjastusühisus Loodus, kelle aukartustäratavalt pikk ja mitmekesine väljaannete rida rikastas oluliselt eestlaste kultuurilist maailmapilti. Looduse eesotsas oli algusest lõpuni Hans Männik - laia silmaringi ja silmapaistva ärilise andega isiksus.

programme.title: Maahommik
programme.desc: Maahommik rändab mööda Eestimaad ringi ja kohtub erinevate inimeste ja nende põnevate tegemistega. Teie ees rullub lahti maaelu värvipalett koos kõikide oma varjunditega. Loomad, taimed, talud, tööd ja musttuhat muud lugu ootab teid just Maahommiku saates. Saatejuht Maili Metssalu, režissöör Mikk Mäe, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Osoon
programme.desc: Käesoleval aastal on sääskedega leviv Lääne-Niiluse viirus nõudnud Euroopas 141 inimelu. Möödunud aastal avastasid teadlased esmakordselt seda viirust kandva sääse ka Eestis. Uurime, kui ohtlikud on meie sääsed ja milliseid haigusi nad kannavad. Aasta kalaks valitud lest on põhjaeluviisiga merekala, keda on võimalik erinevate vahenditega püüda. Proovime koos kalastusekspertidega järele, millise püügiviisiga õnnestub lesta rannikuveest tabada, ja küsime, miks liigil praegu nii kehvasti läheb.

programme.desc: Tauno sekkub kõigi laste ellu ja üritab kummalisel moel lohutada Eevit, kes kardab, kas saab ikka lapsega hakkama. Jani leiab Forssa linnateatrisse sobiva näidendi. Taavi käib ühest politseijaoskonnast teise, et Mikkot üles anda. Severi läheb oma raadiotööd tagasi paluma.

programme.title: My Family

programme.title: Magnolia Table with Joanna Gaines
programme.desc: Joanna makes an Italian meal including Pink Baked Ziti, Roasted Garlic Parmesan Toast and Antipasto Salad with Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette. For a twist on dessert, Joanna deconstructs traditional Italian cannoli. She also gets a surprise from Chip.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: It's the biggest Chopped shake up ever as a wheel of chance will determine the fate of sixteen chefs. In the first battle, four talented chefs must take on baskets containing a glorious seafood product, an amphibious delicacy and a strange beverage.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Owning and operating a restaurant is hard graft, harder than many believe it to be. Long hours, stiff competition, and no guarantees that customers will frequent; for many budding restaurateurs, the dream often turns into a nightmare. This American reality series follows English celebrity chef Robert Irvine as he attempts to save failing restaurants from the brink of collapse. With just two days to turn it around on a measly budget of $10,000, he gets to straight to work identifying and altering the businesses' weaknesses before a grand re-opening. Can he achieve the seemingly impossible and create a food establish that is set to succeed?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy finds righteous ramen in Millcreek, Utah, artichoke parmesan soup in Grand Junction, Colorado, and stuffed cabbage and schnitzel in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Culinary legend Wolfgang Puck makes his first-ever appearance at the Beat Bobby Flay arena alongside Chopped guru Ted Allen. Chefs Emily Hansen and Judy Anderson must impress the dynamic duo to get the chance to fillet the Flay.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Host John Henson has a close encounter with a ghost that inspires ghostly transformation desserts, and one supernatural sweet scares up $1,000 after impressing judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell. But the bottom three bakers aren't so lucky, and they must dig into their personal histories and create a ghost dessert based on an actual ancestor. In the end, the judges are met with their toughest decision of the series yet.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine heads to Chez Olga in Grand Rapids, Mich., where the struggling restaurant is tearing apart the mother and daughter who run it, and Robert must revamp the look, the menu and get the owners to work as partners; bonus content is added.

programme.desc: Food Network's Clinton Kelly and Jet Tila cheer on chef and former Olympian Dawn Burrell and chef Rob Lam from the west coast as they cook against each other before they are given the opportunity to compete against Bobby Flay for the gold.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Chefs Jonathan Meyer and Fernanda Tapia are thrown for a loop when Bobby Flay gives them a challenging star ingredient. Chef Alex Guarnaschelli and Man v. Food's Casey Webb try to ease the pressure with some pranks to throw Bobby off his game!

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: Chef Michelle Wallace feels like the underdog against Bobby Flay's Titans, but she's here to prove her down-home Southern flavors can compete with anyone to win $25,000. Katie Lee Biegel, star of The Kitchen, determines the winner.

programme.title: Bobby Flay's The Line
programme.desc: Longtime Beat Bobby Flay judge Leah Cohen challenges Bobby Flay's home team chefs to a Southeast Asian showdown.

programme.title: Selena + Chef: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Selena Gomez rings in the new year with the help of Chef Eric Adjepong, who brings his bold eclectic flavors to a New Year's Day brunch. Selena's skills are put to the test as she tackles Shrimp and Banana Grits, Scallop Benedict and Kusshi Oysters with Champagne Mignonette. Her friend Raquelle suggests a New Year's tradition that ends with plates shattered across Selena's front porch. The brunch is topped off with one of Chef Eric's all-time favorite desserts, the deliciously sweet and fruity Malva Pudding.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Evil spirits are leaving creepy notes all over the manor, so host John Henson asks the bakers to channel the haunting energy of the entities by creating cryptic message desserts that reveal an eerie dispatch from the other side. For the first time this season, there is only one bake, which means everyone is baking for their lives. Judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell must decide who wins $1,000 for their mysterious missive and whose message now reads exit.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Strawberries steal the show as Michael Symon makes Spatchcock Chicken with a citrus marinade that pairs perfectly with a Strawberry Salad featuring goat cheese and arugula. To top off this strawberry delight, Liz puts together a fresh Strawberry Pie that leaves everyone berry happy.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: The Big Easy is calling, and Michael Symon brings a little kick with his New Orleans-style Gumbo on the Grill topped with jasmine rice. Then, he dips Beignets in a Chicory Chocolate Sauce for some Southern comfort, and Liz sweetens the deal with a Sazerac cocktail.

programme.title: Magnolia Table with Joanna Gaines
programme.desc: Joanna welcomes Angela Kinsey from The Office to cook up some tried-and-true Texas dishes, including Dr Pepper BBQ pulled pork sandwiches, loaded baked potatoes, corn on the cob and peach cobbler.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: It's a full day of working with the calves on the ranch, so Ree Drummond's grilling up a well-deserved tailgate lunch. On the menu are Smoky Salt and Pepper Drumsticks, flame-grilled Cheesy Steakburgers, Grilled Taters with onions and garlic, spicy Street Corn and, wrapping things up, Blueberry Hand Pies.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: For our sibling teams, family is everything, so hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown task the bakers with creating family favorite desserts. They want to learn more about the bakers through these sweet treats, and they want to discover if the bakers can execute under pressure. But that's not all! There's a five-minute baking time extension at stake that puts the bakers into a spin -- literally! In the end, the least successful team is eliminated.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: The sibling bakers share family trip memories by making vacation desserts that reimagine a memorable food experience from a location they visited.

programme.title: Kitchen Chaos

programme.title: Kitchen Chaos
programme.desc: Campfire cooking heats up and wedding cakes collapse as Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey, Gabe Bertaccini, Adrienne Cheatham, and Zac Young weigh in.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: Host Terry Crews invites the 71 remaining cooks to compete in four challenges: a culinary trivia challenge, a spicy weeknight dinner battle, best sandwich, and a mystery basket challenge. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Nick DiGiovanni send six cooks home.

programme.title: Selena + Chef: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Selena Gomez welcomes Chef Alex Guarnaschelli to help her cook a feast for her tree-trimming party. While the family decorates, Selena and Alex prepare an indulgent feast with Fried Mozzarella Sticks and Creamy Marinara, Alex's whipped cream infused Chantilly Mashed Potatoes, Black Pepper Roast Beef and Gravy, and Chocolate Candy Cane Bark to top it off. Alex and Selena make a video call to a very special someone. Later, the gang is joined by Selena's friends and family to enjoy the spread and admire the tree.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: A twisted tale of two souls unfolds as the bakers confront their most chilling challenge yet. The grotesque takes center stage in a nightmarish test of skill when host John Henson asks the bakers to craft a horrifying fusion of two beings into one monstrous spliced souls dessert. Judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell decide which baker best captures the terror of transformation. One baker will win $1,000 -- and one will be eliminated.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Things get sizzling as Michael Symon makes a Grilled Strip Steak with Anchovy Garlic Butter that even non-steak lovers will die for. To lighten things up, he combines fresh tomatoes from his garden with orecchiette for an easy-to-please Pasta Salad, while Liz makes a bourbon-based Boulevardier that shows Michael what he's been missing all his life.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is updating classic pizza recipes; she prepares cauliflower pizzas, chicken Caesar salad pizza and then a watermelon pizza - perfect for kids.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond's sharing the fundamentals of care packages and putting one together for her college kid, Alex, along the way. She's packing up an utterly delicious Lemon and Raspberry Pound Cake, wrapping up Snickerdoodles in the best DIY way, including something healthy with Brown Butter Granola Clusters, stuffing in Strawberry Fruit Roll-Ups that always travel well and throwing in custom-made Hot Chocolate Mixes. It's a care package journey with lots of fun ideas for that special someone.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Paljastavat vankilapuhelut
programme.desc: Rockford, Michigan: 5. elokuuta 2006 41-vuotiaan Renee Beth Pagelin isä löysi hänet kuolleena kotoaan. Tyttö oli puukotettu raa'asti kuoliaaksi. Tapaus oli kylmässä 13 vuotta, ja synkkä ja paha salaisuuksien ja valheiden verkko peitteli sen henkilöllisyyden, joka murhasi sydämettömästi tämän epäitsekkään ja rakastavan kolmen lapsen äidin. Totuus lopulta paljastui, ja paljastus järkytti perhettä, yhteisöä ja tutkijoita. Tapaus kuumeni uudelleen vuonna 2019. Lopulta Reneen aviomies Michael Pagel myönsi syyllisyytensä murhaan. Hän väitti olleensa palkkamurhan suunnittelijana ja väitti, että todellinen tappaja oli hänen oma veljensä Charles Pagel, joka tunnetaan myös nimellä Beau Pagel. Mike Pagel tunnusti syyllisyytensä toisen asteen murhaan 20. toukokuuta 2020. Hänet tuomittiin 25–50 vuodeksi vankeuteen. Mike oli ainoa, joka tuomittiin Reneen kuolemasta. Viranomaiset eivät ole löytäneet päteviä todisteita Charlesia/Beauta vastaan.

programme.desc: Konsumtion, njutning och inflytande. Bakom pengar, sex och makt ligger tre mer generella frestelser som genomsyrar vår kultur. Men den som följer Jesus kan inte samtidigt leva för prylar, upplevelser och bekräftelse. Med Olof Edsinger.

programme.title: Bibeln berikar - Matti Vuolanne
programme.desc: Misstag och missförstånd. Människor gör misstag ibland, men Gud vill ändå använda oss. Genom misstag kan vi inse att vi inte klarar oss utan Jesus.

programme.title: Vändpunkten
programme.desc: Det är inte över. Vi får möta människor i situationer då allt verkar vara förbi. Men då griper Gud in och förändrar allt.

programme.desc: Hur bibelsynen påverkar vårt vägval. Vart leder liberalteologisk bibelsyn i förlängningen i synen på sex och kön? Hur skiljer den sig från bibeltrogen teologi? Professorn och bibelforskaren Anders Gerdmar undervisar.

programme.title: Hur bevara skörden
programme.desc: Billy Graham och skörden. En stor kristen evangelisationskampanj anordnades i Helsingfors Olympiastadion i augusti 1987. Vad var bra och vad var mindre bra? Kenneth Witick talar om nycklar till att bevara nyfrälsta i tron.

programme.title: Klarsyn - Varför tro på Gud?
programme.desc: Design argument utifrån Big Bang. Mats Selander talar om olika förnuftsmässiga aspekter på varför man ska tro på Gud. Tidigare ateist, nu lärare vid CredoAkademin, tar Mats upp de frågor som han själv letade svar på.

programme.title: Upprättelse och lärjungaskap
programme.desc: Finns det ett bibliskt sätt att hantera stress?. Stress är en av vårt tids folksjukdomar. Vi tittar närmare på vad Gud genom Bibeln har att erbjuda oss för att hantera livets utmaningar.

programme.title: Israeler möter Messias
programme.desc: Neriyah. Med en bror som dött i njursvikt såg inte framtiden ljus ut för Neriyah då läkaren konstaterade att han skulle behöva dialys. Men Jesus gör under och sände Cynthia från Amerika.

programme.title: Att leda en församling
programme.desc: Mod. Det behövs mod i Guds rike. Mose fick mod från Gud att gå tillbaka till Egypten där hans egen berättelse hade börjat. Ibland kan vi behöva gå tillbaka för att utmana någon vi länge haft på hjärtat.

programme.title: Shalom över Israel - Konferens
programme.desc: För en tid som denna. Shalom över Israel firar 90 år för det judiska folket! Ordförande Robin Lundgren hälsar välkommen till jubileiumskonferensen och pastor Annika Bertilsson tar med oss till Esters bok.

programme.title: Dietrich Bonhoeffer: predikanten och hakkorset
programme.desc: Bonhoeffer var en tysk teolog som avrättades för sitt motstånd mot Hitler. Idag hyllas han över politiska och teologiska gränser och hans skrifter har fortfarande stort inflytande i hela den kristna världen.

programme.title: Kungen kommer
programme.desc: Josef - upphöjd broder. Josef förespeglar Messias liv, död och uppståndelse, men även hur han uppenbaras för sina bröder judarna i ändens svåra tider. Daniela Persin samtalar med Martin Persin och Emanuel Zethson. 4 Mos 27.

programme.title: TV7 Israelnyheter
programme.desc: TV7 Israelnyheter

programme.title: Gershon Nerels Israel
programme.desc: Den romerska tiden i Israel 1/2. Då Rom erövrade Judeen var det uppfyllelsen av profeten Daniels dröm. På vilket sätt påverkade romarnas ankomst livet i Israel?

programme.title: Svar på en minut
programme.desc: Kalams kosmologiska argument. Hur pekar det kalam-kosmologiska argumentet på Guds existens? Bobby Conway intervjuar doktor William Lane Craig.

programme.title: Vision 70 - till jordens yttersta gräns
programme.desc: Du är Guds tempel. Guds närvaro finns också i dig genom den Helige Ande och det gör dig till Guds tempel! Du kan tillbe Gud var som helst och du kan vara mötesplatsen där himlen kommer ner till andra. Med Christer Borg.

programme.title: Tävlingslopp - Kortfilm
programme.desc: Livet är som ett långt löplopp. Ibland rullar det lätt, men däremellan går det tungt och uppförsbackarna tycks aldrig ta slut. Men i Jesus finns alltid kraft att få -ge inte upp!

programme.title: Israel talar
programme.desc: Bön för Israel. I september 2012 var det åter dags för den årliga bönekonferensen för alla folk under ledning av Tom Hess. Deltagare från över 180 länder samlades i Jerusalem för att be för Israel och nationerna. Bönestöd för det Heliga landet är viktigt, särskilt i dessa dagar när Irans kärnvapenprogram hotar hela Israels existens.

programme.title: Café Bibeln Uppsala
programme.desc: Att sluta fred med sin bakgrund. Omständigheterna kring en människas födsel och första tid kan vara komplicerade. Men Guds nåd och frid kan förvandla vilken situation som helst. Jan Nilsson berättar för Leif Nummela om sitt liv.

programme.desc: Josef - upphöjd broder. Josef förespeglar Messias liv, död och uppståndelse, men även hur han uppenbaras för sina bröder judarna i ändens svåra tider. Daniela Persin samtalar med Martin Persin och Emanuel Zethson. 4 Mos 27.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Har Megiddossa antoi nimensä Harmageddonille, Ilmestyskirjan tuomionpäivän taistelulle. Tutkimme tälle kukkulalle rakennettujen kaupunkien historiaa.

programme.title: Roswell: The First Witness
programme.desc: Tutkija Ben Smith matkaa Jesse Marcelin kotikaupunkiin. Kun maaperä- ja metallianalyysin sekä rikosteknisen käsiala-analyysin tulokset saapuvat, Smith jakaa saadut tiedot Marcelin isoisäänsä uskovien lastenlasten kanssa.

programme.title: Doomsday: 10 Ways The World Will End
programme.desc: Kolmas maailmansota syttyy ja ydinpainajaisesta tulee totta, kun tuhannet vetypommit tuhoavat maailman suurimmat kaupungit. Tätä seuraavana talvena sadot epäonnistuvat koko maailmassa, ja massanälkiintyminen ajaa ihmiskunnan tuhon partaalle.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: WATUlla ja ONS 5:llä on tärkeä kohtaaminen Atlantin taistelussa. Dönitz ottaa käyttöön uuden torpedon, jonka kohteena ovat muita saattavat alukset. Robertsin ja Laidlaw’n on keksittävä vastaus uuteen aseeseen ja saatava aaltojen herruus takaisin.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Egyptin hieroglyfeissä viitataan hautojen hehkulamppuihin ja salakammioihin. Hallitsivatko muinaiset ihmiset sähkön? Opettivatko muukalaiset sen heille?

programme.title: Brad Melzerin tulkinnat
programme.desc: Miljoonat yhdysvaltalaiset uskovat ufoihin, mutta hallitus ei suostu vahvistamaan huhuja Roswellin tapauksesta tai huippusalaisesta Area 51:n tukikohdasta. Sotavoimien huippujärjestöt vastaavat vihdoin kysymyksiin ufojen maailmasta.

programme.title: Maanalaiset kaupungit
programme.desc: Moskova tunnetaan armottomista johtajistaan ja runsaista salaisuuksistaan, Moskovan vilkkaiden katujen alta löytyy sodan jälkiä ja Stalinin kammottava perintö.

programme.title: Brad Melzerin tulkinnat
programme.desc: Uskotaan että erään kardinaalin varastama salaperäinen luonnos oli osa Da Vincin kryptisiä ennustuksia. Jaksossa syvennytään Da Vincin kohuttuihin poliittisiin kantoihin, pakkomielteeseen kuolemaa kohtaan ja Mona Lisan henkilöllisyyden arvoitukseen.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Venäjän ensimmäinen tsaari eli julman ja arvaamattoman elämän. Seuraa tarinaa hänen valtakuntansa vahvistumisesta ja laajenemisesta.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: Siitä lähtien, kun Canterburyn arkkipiispa Thomas Becket murhattiin katedraalissa vuonna 1170, uskovaiset pyhiinvaeltajat ovat etsiytyneet kaupunkiin kunnioittaakseen häntä. Tiimi etsii vieraiden pudottamia helyjä ja matkamuistoja eri vuosisadoilta.

programme.title: Doomsday: 10 Ways The World Will End
programme.desc: Kun kahden tähden törmäyksestä syntyvä gammasädepurkaus osuu ilmakehäämme, säteily tuhoaa puolet maapallosta. Amerikassa odottaa hitaampi kuolema, kun ultraviolettisäteily ja nälänhätä uhkaavat koko ihmiskunnan kohtaloa.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Josh Bernstein tutkii miksi mayat rakensivat tuhansia pyramideja. Hän matkaa Meksikoon ja Guatemalaan etsimään salaista maailmaa.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Paljastuuko Leonardo da Vincin mestariteoksista, teknisistä luonnospiirroksista sekä henkilökohtaisista päiväkirjoista, että mestari tunsi maapallon ulkopuolista teknologiaa ja oli yhteydessä muukalaisolentoihin?

programme.title: Eating History
programme.desc: Houston, meillä on peruna. Old Smokey ja Josh matkaavat kaukaiseen paikkaan avaruusperunoiden perässä. Sitten he kokkaavat vallankumousriisiä ja vierailevat tilalla etsimässä unohdettuja herkkuja.

programme.title: Eating History
programme.desc: Kaikki ei ole kunnossa, kun miehet testaavat vuoden 1953 hätäpakkauksen juomavesivarontoja. Legendaarisen kokin klassiset italialaiset purkkiruoat osoittautuvat yllättävän säilyviksi.

programme.title: Modern Marvels: Food
programme.desc: Adam opettelee historiaa sekä uskomattomia tietoja ja prosesseja, jotka ovat Amerikan rakastetuimpien ruokien takana.

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: Amerikkalaiset ovat ahmineet kiinalaista noutoruokaa siitä asti, kun kiinalaiset maahanmuuttajat saapuivat Amerikkaan 1800-luvun keskivaiheilla. Oletko koskaan miettinyt, mitä kevätrulla todella sisältää? Tiesitkö, että onnenkeksistä voi rikastua?

programme.title: Lost Worlds

programme.title: Panttilainaamo
programme.desc: Kun asiakas astuu kauppaan kameran kanssa, jolla kuvattiin ensimmäinen kuvamateriaali Elviksestä, saavatko Rick ja Corey hyvän diilin vai palauttavatko he sen? Sitten Chum yrittää etsiä tietoa salaperäisestä fossiilista.

programme.title: Panttilainaamo
programme.desc: Kun Alice Cooperin oletettavasti käyttämä asu päätyy tiskille, Rick tekee kaikkensa yrittäessään saada aikaan sopimuksen. Sitten Chum alkaa laskelmoida, kun hän tekee tarjouksen parimetrisestä Deadpoolin näköisestä PEZ - annostelijasta.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Saiko raamatullinen patriarkka ohjeita 200 enkeliltä korkealla maan yläpuolella? Opetettiinko antiikin kreikkalaisille metallin työstämistä kala-ihmisten rodun toimesta? Ja olisiko Egyptin kiistellyin faarao voinut olla maan ulkopuolinen olento?

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries With Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Sisällissodan viimeisinä päivinä Konfederaation johtajat pakenivat etelään, ja huhujen mukaan heillä oli mukanaan Konfederaation valtionkassa, jonka arvo nykyrahassa olisi noin 13 miljoonaa dollaria. Mihin varastetut rahat päätyivät?

programme.title: Huutokaupan metsästäjät
programme.desc: Moreno Valleyn helteessä Kennyllä on vaikeuksia nimien kanssa, joten hän tekee äkkiratkaisun. Samaan aikaan Brandi ei pääse helpolla ilman apua ylhäältä. Dave on jumissa epätyydyttävän varaston kanssa...

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries With Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Egyptin aavikon hiekasta kohoaa yksi muinaisen maailman suurimmista ihmeistä - mahtava sfinksi. Tämä mytologinen olento, jolla on ihmisen pää ja leijonan vartalo, näyttää seisovan vartiossa Gizan suurilla pyramideilla.

programme.title: Pawn Stars Do America
programme.desc: Rick, Corey ja Chum käynnistävät moottorit ja saapuvat Detroitiin, Michiganiin. Suosikkiasiantuntijoidensa kanssa Rick pukeutuu samuraihaarniskoihin ja yrittää saada luksusautomalliston hintaa alas.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: Arkeologit ovat yrittäneet ratkaista jo vuosisatoja miksi ja miten tehtiin tietyt uskomattomat rakennelmat, kuten Gizan pyramidi, Loretton kappelin portaat ja Coral Castle. Löydämmekö koskaan vastauksia?

programme.title: Pawn Stars Do America

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner

programme.title: Panttilainaamo

programme.title: Panttilainaamo

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot

programme.title: Slave Trade
programme.desc: This film explores and documents the strange but prophetic mid-1990s period in Prince's career during which he took full control of his music and the way it was sold. With the help of those who witnessed the key events as they unfolded, this feature shows that Prince is not just a remarkable musician, performer and composer, but arguably, also has the shrewdest brain in show business.

programme.title: Shakira Oral Fixation Tour 2007

programme.title: Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama in a once in a lifetime concert event, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band. Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.title: Austin City Limits

programme.title: AC/DC - Live At The Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: Duran Duran - The Reunion Tour: Live at Wembley
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: Rio, Hungry Like The Wolf, The Reflex and many more…

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary

programme.title: 2CELLOS: Live in London
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his Scratch My Back album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed.

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: The murders of women in the Baton Rouge and Lafayette areas of southern Louisiana between 2002 and 2003. Derrick Todd Lee was eventually convicted of two of the killings, while many believe he was responsible for all seven.

programme.title: The Shadows Of Death

programme.title: Still A Mystery

programme.title: Disappeared

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: In 2004, a devoted group of Insane Clown Posse followers known as “the Juggalettes” rule the halls of the Blackhawk alternative high school in Illinois. However, when the Queen of the Clowns invites a new girl into her group, things turn deadly serious.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders

programme.desc: Ensimmäisessä tarinassa Herkko palkataan televisioon meteorologiksi. Toisessa tarinassa Herkko päättää ryhtyä kirjailijaksi. Kolmannessa tarinassa Herkko ja Tirrinen löytävät sattumalta ullakolta hiiriyhdyskunnan. Kouluikäisille suunnattu animaatiosarja possun ja kärpäsen ystävyydestä. Uutta hienostuneempaa sikaelämää tavoitteleva Possu toivoisi, että Kärpänen jättäisi hänet rauhaan. Kärpänen on kuitenkin päättänyt, että Possu on hänen paras ystävänsä ja täydellinen juuri sellaisena kuin on, sorkat mudassa. Sarja on suomeksi puhuttu.

programme.title: Possu ja Kärpänen (S)
programme.desc: Ensimmäisessä tarinassa Herkko päättää osoittaa urheilutaitonsa. Toisessa tarinassa Herkko ja Tirrinen päättävät sabotoida Tylysen tanssiharjoitukset. Kolmannessa tarinassa Tirrinen heittää vahingossa pois Herkon rakkaan pehmoeläinpupun. Kouluikäisille suunnattu animaatiosarja possun ja kärpäsen ystävyydestä. Uutta hienostuneempaa sikaelämää tavoitteleva Possu toivoisi, että Kärpänen jättäisi hänet rauhaan. Kärpänen on kuitenkin päättänyt, että Possu on hänen paras ystävänsä ja täydellinen juuri sellaisena kuin on, sorkat mudassa. Sarja on suomeksi puhuttu.

programme.title: The Floor Suomi
programme.desc: Yllätyskilpailija mullistaa pelin ennätyksellisellä voittoputkellaan! Jaksopalkinto on kuitenkin uhattuna, kun uusi haastaja astuu esiin. Salamannopeat musiikkitietäjät iskevät yhteen huikeassa sekuntipelissä.

programme.title: Kolmiodraama
programme.desc: Kausi 2, 8/12. Kahdenkeskinen aika tulee päätökseen ja arki mullistuu jälleen. Yhteisissä juhlissa riittää säpinää, kun kutsu on ensimmäistä kertaa koko kolmikolle.

programme.title: Race Across The World Suomi
programme.desc: Viisi paria suuntaa kohti Jejun saarta, jossa ratkeavat finalistit. Väsymys, hupenevat rahat, kielimuuri ja eksymiset koettelevat kilpailijoita. Matkalla koetaan suuria oivalluksia, toteutetaan lapsuuden haaveita ja ajaudutaan riitojen partaalle. Jokainen valinta voi ratkaista, ketkä jatkavat finaaliin.

programme.title: Poliisit UK: Ajojahti (12)

programme.title: Salatut elämät (S)
programme.desc: Jakso 5019 Ultra brasanoi Norjalainen, kun sikiön tutki. Pihlajakatu 23 B on täynnä naurua, itkua, rakkautta ja suuria salaisuuksia.

programme.title: Liikennepoliisit UK (12)
programme.desc: Takaa-ajon tiimellyksessä poliisin päälle viskotaan kovassa vauhdissa sekä mönkijä että vasara. Varastettua pakettiautoa kuljettanut mies myöntää syyllisyytensä saaden sekä ehdollista että ajokieltoa.

programme.title: Pitääkö olla huolissaan?
programme.desc: Kausi 11, 12/12. Hei hei Hotakainen. Tämä on viimeinen jakso kun huolipaneelissa istuu Kari Hotakainen. Eläkepäiviä odottelevat myös: Jenni Pääskysaari, Miika Nousiainen, ja Tuomas Kyrö. Vieraana muusikko Mikko Kuustonen.

programme.title: Tämä on tämä

programme.title: Poliisit UK: Ajojahti (12)
programme.desc: Northamptonshiren poliisikoirat antavat mestarinäytöksen jäljitystaidoistaan, moottoritiellä rikotaan nopeusennätyksiä, ja ajoneuvorekisteri aiheuttaa harmaita hiuksia itse kullekin.

programme.title: Liikennepoliisit UK (12)
programme.desc: Sekavan oloinen pariskunta kolaroi moottoritien rampilla yritettyään varastaa tavaraa kaupasta. Poliisit nappaavat kiinni etsintäkuulutetun nuorukaisen, jolla on sangen pitkä rikostausta.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers (7)
programme.desc: Tina lähtee partiolaisten suunnistusleirille mutta eksyy kahden kaverinsa kanssa nuorten tyttöjen etikettikouluun, jossa kaikki ei todellakaan tunnu olevan kohdallaan.

programme.title: Stadi vs. Lande
programme.desc: Stadin joukkueet miettivät, onko Iisalmesta Kiuruvedelle kuinka pitkä matka. Landen puolella taas pohditaan, mitä tapahtuu kun skolen pihalla on flaidis. Stadin riveissä kilpailevat joukkueet Geepiste ja Tsadin tsirbulat. Landen puolella nähdään Hurmion kätilöt ja MM-mestarit. Juontajina Jaakko Saariluoma ja Joonas Nordman.

programme.title: NHL-sirkus

programme.title: Beck: Mainostaja (14) (16)
programme.desc: Nainen joutuu raa'an hyökkäyksen kohteeksi pyöräretkellä metsässä. Hänen onnistuu paeta. Paetessaan hän saa laitettua kännykkänsä päälle ja onnistuu juuri ottamaan yhteyden mieheensä, kun hänen äänensä katoaa. Mies soittaa epätoivoisena poliisille. Beck miehineen löytää metsästä naisen ruumiin. Rikostutkinnan yhteydessä tulee esille eräs kännykkänumero. Numero, joka mitä ilmeisimmin on peräisin ilmoituksesta.

programme.title: Köln 75 (12)
programme.desc: Köln 75 kertoo tositarinan yhdestä kaikkien aikojen myydyimmistä jazzlevyistä, Keith Jarrettin “Köln Concert” -konsertista vuodelta 1975. Tapahtuma oli vähällä peruuntua – kunnes määrätietoinen saksalainen teini, 18-vuotias Vera Brandes, tekee kaikkensa järjestääkseen olosuhteet mestariteoksen synnylle. Vera, joka käy yhä koulua aloittaessaan konserttien tuotannon ja promoamisen Kölnissä, panee peliin aivan kaiken saadakseen tämän konsertin toteutumaan. Kaikki tuntuu olevan häntä vastaan, mutta Vera uskoo musiikin voimaan – eikä hän ole koskaan nähnyt kenenkään soittavan samalla tavalla kuin Keith Jarrett.

programme.title: NG Wild: Villit, viekkaat ja vaaralliset
programme.desc: Naamiointi, jäljittely ja huomaamattomuus kuuluvat maailman älykkäimpien eläinten selviytymiskeinoihin. Aina tiikereistä, jotka käyttävät oranssia turkkiaan naamioituakseen saalistaessaan, hämähäkkiin, joka jäljittelee muurahaista livahtaakseen yhdyskuntaan, ja lintuihin, jotka väärillä hälytyksillä huijaavat mangusteja luopumaan saaliistaan, nämä eläimet ovat loistavia hämäyksen mestareita.

programme.title: NG Wild: Villit, viekkaat ja vaaralliset
programme.desc: Joskus pelkkä raaka voima ei riitä, kun pitää paeta petoja tai päihittää vastustajia. Tapaamme maailman ainutlaatuisimpia eläimiä, jotka selviytyäkseen käyttävät poikkeuksellisia supervoimia, kuten kuolemaa uhmaavaa akrobatiaa, salaisia aisteja ja piilotettuja aseita.

programme.title: Afrikan jokien titaanit
programme.desc: Afrikan mahtavat joet ovat koti monille erilaisille mahtaville asukkaille, kuten norsuille ja virtahevoille, jotka syövät ja juovat siellä, missä krokotiilit metsästävät ja lisääntyvät. Me paljastamme, miten nämä massiiviset eläimet jakavat vesistöt vastahakoisesti muiden pienempien olentojen, kuten piikkisikojen, gasellikotkien ja leopardien, kanssa.

programme.title: Savannien valtiaat
programme.desc: Afrikan syrjäseuduilla pieni villikoiraperhe pakenee ja etsii epätoivoisesti turvallista paikkaa kasvattaa kuutta pentua. Turvapaikka, jota ne etsivät, on kuitenkin täynnä kilpailijoita ja saalistajia, jotka haluavat syödä niiden pennut. Vain niiden laumanjohtajien, Teemanan ja Malaon, päättäväisyys voi pelastaa ne.

programme.title: Preerikoiden kartano
programme.desc: Junen on keksittävä, mitä tehdä koloon tunkevan orvoksi jääneen Vince-pennun kanssa. Highlandsissa Scarlettin pelottomat poikaset jahtaavat kahta mäyrää, mikä johtaa kuolettaviin seuraamuksiin. Flatlandissa Ruby yrittää koulia poikasensa Kipin syömään itsenäisesti, ennen kuin emon maito loppuu.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Espanjan Sierra de Gredosin kansallispuisto on yksi Euroopan upeimmista luonnonmaisemista, ja se paljastetaan ohjelmassa eri vuodenaikojen kierron kautta. Löydämme hauraan ekosysteemin ikivanhoilta onsilojäätiköiltä, syvistä vuoristorotkoista ja Pico de Almanzorista, joka on Espanjan korkein vuorenhuippu. Täällä hallitsee pyreneittenvuohi, ikoninen eläin, joka määrittelee näiden vuorten hengen. Sen rinnalla maakotkat, alppilinnut ja saukot asuttavat tätä eristäytyneisyyden ja sitkeyden muovaamaa aluetta. Tämä on kuvaus luonnosta ja tasapainosta sekä ikkuna yhteen Euroopan viimeisistä suurista erämaa-alueista.

programme.desc: Pohjoisen New Mexicon preeriakoiria uhkaavat monet vaarat, niin pienet kuin suuretkin. Flatlandsissa Junen kiusana ovat kirput. Highlandsissa Champille käy huonosti peuhatessa, ja seikkailu pesäkolon luota johtaa Poncen vieraalle alueelle.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Alpit muuttuvat, eivät dramaattisin harppauksin vaan hitain, tasaisin muutoksin. Lämpötilan nousu ja vuosikymmeniä jatkunut ihmisen toiminta muuttavat tätä kerran vakaata vuoristoaluetta. Alppivuohi, murmelit ja kiirunat kohtaavat kaikki omat haasteensa vuoristomaailmassa, mutta muutokset tuovat myös uusia mahdollisuuksia. Miten eri lajit sopeutuvat? Laaksoissa jokien muuttunut virtaus uhkaa lintulajeja, jotka pesivät avoimella soralla. Koemme liikkeessä olevan hauraan maailman.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Syksy muuttaa Karpaattien vuorenrinteet laajoiksi pronssin, meripihkan ja kullan sävyisiksi matoiksi. Metsät kaikuvat isokauriiden voimakkaista mylvinnöistä, jotka viestivät niiden taistelevan oikeudesta paimentaa naaraita. Käydään gladiaattoritaistelu, ja heikentyneet häviäjät joutuvat metsään susilaumojen poimittaviksi, kun ne etsivät helppoa ateriaa. Karhujen on aika ahmia itsensä täyteen marjoja ja pähkinöitä, jotta ne lihoisivat ennen talviunta. Valtavasta koostaan huolimatta ne kiipeilevät pyökkien ja mäntyjen runkoja pitkin yltääkseen aivan latvassa oleviin mehukkaimpiin herkkuihin. Ne jopa eksyvät ihmisten maastoon ryöstelemään viljapeltoja, valmiina tekemään mitä tahansa tyydyttääkseen nälkänsä. Kaikkien näiden upeiden olentojen selviytyminen riippuu vanhoista puista, jotka imevät haitallista hiiltä ilmakehästä ja säätelevät maapallon lämpötilaa, jotta kaikki voisivat elää.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Saksan keskivuoriston hiljainen viehätys piilee sen muinaisissa metsissä ja villissä kauneudessa. Syksyisen metsän läpi jylisevä hirven kutsuhuuto kaikuu sumun läpi. Nyt on kiima-aika! Saksin Sveitsissä muuttohaukat ja mustahaikarat elävät maalauksellisilla kallioilla. Välttelevä ilves vaeltelee metsissä, kun taas Harzissa uusi, villimpi metsä kasvaa muuttuvassa ilmastossa.
